messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty — incident triggered: service=inference-gateway-eu-west1, symptom=5xx_rate spike (502). threshold=5% over 5m. paging: @sre-oncall :rotating_light: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

alice: acked in PD, I'm on. any recent deploys?

ben: no app deploy in last 30m. there was an ingress config rollout ~10m ago (ingress-config-v12).

charlie: seeing autoscaler churn around the same time, scaled down some inference pods at 17:42 GMT, might be warmup gap.

alice: metrics quick view:
```
502_rate (5m): 6.8%
p95 latency: 420ms
requests/s: 1200 -> 900
error-path: /v1/embeddings/proxy
```

ben: can we divert to standby model variant while we triage? standby has headroom.

alice: yes, let's shift traffic to standby variant. prefer gradual splay. tagging customer-impact=unknown until we know.

ben: preparing route change: `/ops/route set inference-eu weight=standby:10` then increment. doing dry-run first.

ops_lead: splay policy: 10% steps / 60s, watch 502 and latency. avoid >30% jump at once.

ben: dry-run ok. flipping 10% -> 30% now.

alice: after 30s: 502_rate -> 3.1%, p95 -> 380ms. requests/s rising slightly. good signal.

pagerbot: PagerDuty update: PD12345 acked by alice, escalation paused.

charlie: found a likely root cause: ingress env var `PROXY_BUFFER_SIZE` was unintentionally set to a low value in the config rollout; upstream buffer overflow led to 502s under bursty traffic.

ben: rolling back ingress-config-v12 to v11 across eu-west1 (3 clusters). initiating gradual rollback.

ben: rollback command: `kubectl apply -f ingress-v11.yaml --context=eu-west1` (rolling updates).

alice: monitoring post-rollback: 502_rate dropping to 0.8% after pods reconcile. p95 350ms.

charlie: autoscaler note: because of the scale-down event earlier, some pods needed cold-starts; combined with smaller PROXY_BUFFER_SIZE caused transient failures. add warmup traffic for scale-up.

ben: rollback complete on all clusters. verifying.

alice: 502_rate now 0.2%, requests/s back to 1180, p95 310ms. marking customer-impact=no (no confirmed customer errors beyond transient).

ops_lead: great. please open a postmortem draft: include ingress rollout checklist, autoscaler warmup, and the env var guard. assign owners.

alice: will draft PM and link to this thread. initial action items: 1) add preflight config diff check, 2) add K/V guard for PROXY_BUFFER_SIZE, 3) autoscaler warmup tweak, 4) rollback playbook update.

ben: adding runbook note: `if 5xx spike after config rollout, check ingress envs -> rollback -> shift traffic to standby`

alice: logging these items in the incident board and pinging eng-oncall for review.

charlie: FYI — no customer pages observed via support, just internal alerts.

alice: closing PD in 10m if stable. will postmortem in #postmortems once draft ready.

ops_lead: thanks team. nice quick mitigation and rollback. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PagerDuty — PD12345 resolved (closed by alice).
